patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I'm fine, I just had a few. Okay, more than a few. Buddies dropped me off. I'm not hurt anywhere — I can walk, I just need to sleep it off, honestly.
clinical.presentationShort: 42yo M ? brought by friends after heavy alcohol use; drowsy but conversant, ambulatory, protecting airway, no evident trauma or focal neurological deficit.
clinical.presentationLong: 42-year-old male brought by friends after heavy alcohol use. He is drowsy but conversant, walking without assistance, and protecting his airway; examination shows no evident injury or focal neurological deficit.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → observe, check glucose, screen for occult trauma/co-ingestion, reassess when sober; discharge when safe.
diagnosis.why: Intoxication is a diagnosis of exclusion — check a sugar, look for head injury, reassess when sober before you clear them.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 42-year-old man, disheveled, slouched on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slouched back, relaxed and bleary. Expression: bleary and half-smiling. Clearly visible: a slouched, disheveled, intoxicated posture. No text, no logos.
